DECRQSS m · after a rendition.reason: The reference always reports the default rendition. Thrush reports the rendition the program set, so a program that saves its rendition this way can restore it.

DECRQSS SP q · after DECSCUSR 6.reason: The reference always reports a block, blinking only after DECSET 12. Thrush reports the shape and blink the program chose with DECSCUSR, so a program that saves its cursor style this way can restore it.

DECRST 7 · then a combining mark after a.reason: Without autowrap the reference drops a wide character that doesn't fit at the right margin, but the next combining mark still takes that character's width, so the a it joins becomes two columns wide. Thrush keeps the á one column wide, as the a was.

ED 1 · at the bottom right corner.reason: The reference throws the same TypeError as from a pending wrap, before it erases the rows above, and swallows the * that follows. Thrush completes the erase and then prints the * normally.

ED 1 · at the right margin below history.reason: The reference clears the wrap flag of the buffer row at the cursor's screen index without adding the history offset, so it unwraps a history row and leaves the next visible row wrapped. Thrush keeps history and its wrap flags intact, and clears the wrap flag of the row after the cursor.

ED 1 · from a pending wrap on the bottom.reason: The reference clears the bottom row, then throws a TypeError clearing the wrap flag of a row below the screen, before it erases the rows above. The throw also leaves its parser inside the sequence, so the * that follows is swallowed. Thrush completes the erase, leaving every row through the cursor blank with its wrap flag clear, and then prints the * normally.

resize · narrower above text.reason: Narrowing makes room for added rows by removing rows from the bottom while the cursor is above it. The reference's bottom-up pass keeps its starting index and goes on to reflow rows it has already removed, so the c of abc returns without the row that held ab. Thrush reflows only the rows that remain.

resize · narrower with combining marks.reason: Narrowing shifts the cells of a continued row right within that row. The reference moves combining marks in column order, so a mark that lands on a later mark's column overwrites it before that mark moves, and the é becomes a second ñ. Thrush keeps each mark on its own character.

RIS.reason: The reference's full reset keeps a cursor that DECTCEM hid, because it stores cursor visibility apart from the modes it resets, though its DECSTR shows the cursor. Thrush shows the cursor after RIS, as a power-on terminal does.
